minecraft:written_book_content.title: Final Dispatch
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Captain Rusk
pages: {"text":"The perimeter was intact at first watch. At second watch, every lookout reported movement beyond a different wall."}
{"text":"We were ordered to hold position. The command post was empty."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The station timetable lists a final departure after the line had been sealed. The destination is written only as 'below'."}
